D/ FL VL CONSTANTINIVS NOB C ; R/ [PROVIDENTIAE AVGG]

A Roman copper alloy nummus of Constantius II (AD 323-361), dating to the period c.AD 324-330 (Reece period 15). PROVIDENTIAE AVGG reverse type shows a camp gateway with two turrets and a star in the middle. Illegible mint. Obverse description: Laureate, draped, and cuirassed bust left.
